Stock Emerald (BPEE) boots through title and intro on a blank 128 KiB Flash image; the save contains no progress, and no full-game, audio, performance, or broad compatibility claim is made. Pokemon is a trademark of Nintendo/Creatures Inc./GAME FREAK inc.; the screenshot is one non-redistributed portfolio excerpt. No ROM, BIOS, or save data is published.

flagships.name: ProofPath

flagships.test_evidence: 612/612 vitest tests passed (66 test files, 1 skipped; Pyodide worker isolation, SQLite persistence, evidence trust)
